verdict.rationale: monday's AI agents can be assigned items and @mentioned to generate 'replies, statuses, and follow-ups' within workflows, suggesting some capacity to draft status-related content from board activity, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'status update' or 'initiative report' drafting feature tied to recent activity. Missing for 10: a specific status-update/report-generation feature description, evidence of summarizing recent activity into a report, and any independent confirmation of this working in practice.
